context: Kenji and Sakura collaborate on a manga illustration; quiet creative session.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: さくら、この場面の動機、はっきりさせよか。
lines.en: Sakura — let's nail down what's driving this scene.
lines.style: Warm, deliberate Kansai lilt. Leans back slightly, hands open. Speaking to a collaborator he trusts. Encouraging without being performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、隠し要素、当てたい。
lines.en: Yeah, I want to nail that hidden detail.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before responding. Soft voice, eyes tracking the logic. Not rushing. The tone of someone working through something alongside someone else.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 角度、ちょっと伸ばして、変えるか。
lines.en: What if we stretch that angle out a bit? Change the approach?
lines.style: Measured, slightly leaning forward. Not suggesting — offering. The ease of someone who's comfortable being questioned back. Warm curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 創作、面白くなってきた!
lines.en: Yeah, this is really coming together now!
lines.style: Brightness breaks through suddenly. Quick, genuine. No performance — just the uncovered delight of something clicking into place. Energy forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 集中、お互いに、できとるな。
lines.en: We're really locked in together on this.
lines.style: Satisfied observation. Slight smile in the voice. Not commenting on himself but on the moment — the rightness of two people working as one. Warm and unforced.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ベル鳴ったら、休憩しよう。
lines.en: Let's take a break when the bell rings.
lines.style: Practical, small-kind. No fuss. The suggestion of someone thinking about the rhythm of the work — not just the work itself. Matter-of-fact warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: This is good work. Real good work, the two of us.
lines.style: Tender, genuine. Slight catch of affection in 「ええ仕事や」. Not effusive — just honest. The kind of praise that lands because it's rare and means something.
